contexts.text: Bethuel begat Rebekah () = from good their affection of truth.
Rebekah, here, = truth to be initiated to good.
Rebekah, in this chapter, = the Divine truth which is to be conjoined with the Divine good of the Rational (Isaac).

Rebekah came out () = the affection of truth from doctrinals; for Rebekah represents truth Divine to be conjoined with the Divine good of the Rational; but here, before she was betrothed, she puts on the representation of the affection of truth from doctrinals; for thence is truth... Rebekah represents that in the Rational which is conjoined as a wife with her husband; and this is Divine truth.
This illustration in the natural man is from good, yet is through truth; (and) is that which is signified by Rebekah drawing for the camels, and giving them to drink.
Rebekah = the affection of truth. AC 3112. AC 3133. AC 3164. AC 3165. AC 3179.
Rebekah = truth from the natural man (which was to be conjoined with the good in the Rational). AC 3153.
They sent away Rebekah their sister () = separation from the affection of truth Divine.
Rebekah arose () = the elevation and consequent separation of the affection of truth. Explained.
Rebekah lifted up her eyes and saw Isaac () = the reciprocal intention of the affection of truth.
In his receiving Rebekah () = the conjunction of Divine truth.
His woman was barren () = as yet no Divine Natural; (for) woman (Rebekah) = the Divine truth conjoined with the good of the Rational.
Rebekah his woman conceived () = (the origin of the Divine Natural) from Divine truth as a mother; for Rebekah = the Divine truth of the Rational.
Rebekah loved Jacob () = that the Divine truth of the Divine Rational loved the doctrine of truth.
Rebekah = the Divine truth of the Lord's Divine Rational.

He feared to say My woman; for perhaps the men of the place will kill me on account of Rebekah () = that Divine truths themselves could not be opened, because in that case Divine good would not be received... Rebekah = the Lord's Divine Rational as to Divine truth.
Isaac was laughing with Rebekah his woman () = that Divine good was present in Divine truth... Rebekah = the Divine truth of the Lord's Rational.
Isaac and Rebekah () = the Lord's Divine Rational as to Divine good and Divine truth.

Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau () = the affection of truth, and the life from it. Rebekah = the Lord's Divine Rational as to the Divine truth conjoined with the Divine good there; thus the very affection of truth.
Rebekah said to Jacob her son () = the Lord's perception from Divine truth concerning natural truth.
Isaac = the rational mind as to the good of the will; and Rebekah, as to the truth of the understanding. AC 3576.
Rebekah, who is here speaking, () = the Divine truth of the Divine Rational.
Jacob said to Rebekah his mother () = the Lord's perception from Divine truth concerning natural truth. AC 3531.
Rebekah, who is here mother () = the Divine Rational as to truth.
Rebekah, who here is her () = the Divine truth of the Divine Rational. AC 3539. AC 3545.
The words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah () = the Lord's perception from Divine truth concerning the mind of natural good then.
(Rebekah) called to Jacob her younger son () = the state of the apperception of the affection of truth from influx through Divine truth.
Rebekah said to Isaac () = the Lord's perception from Divine truth.
Collateral good... was conjoined in brotherhood with the rational truth represented by Rebekah the mother of Jacob.
Rebekah = truth Divine conjoined with the good Divine of the Rational.
See Deborah (Rebekah's nurse).
From mediate influx through the truth of the Rational, or Rebekah.
Rebekah represents the Lord's Divine Rational as to truth; and Rebekah is not mentioned here.
Rebekah represents this truth (of the Rational).
